_README: Per-income-year IRS deduction ceilings, for the past-year re-audit tool. A re-audit of year N MUST use year N's rules, not today's - proven necessary, not academic: art. 78.º-E (rendas) was amended by Lei 82/2023 (OE 2024) and Lei 36/2024, so its ceiling differs across 2023/2024/2025. Assuming today's value for past years would ship wrong numbers (the same green-but-wrong class as the Excel-serial and page-count bugs).
_provenance_shape: Every value carries {value, income_year, article, source_url, verified, verified_on, note} so each number self-documents which year and which diploma it came from (the one pattern worth borrowing from recibocerto's Sourced<T>). NEVER hand a value to a user while verified=false.
_method: Current (in-force) text + full amendment history come from each article's DEDICATED DRE page (id after 2014-70048167-<id>), NOT the full consolidated render - the consolidated view does not expose per-article 'Alteracoes ao artigo' accordions. Historical (past-year) values require viewing the article as-in-force at that year, still TO DO for the changed articles below.
